Mario Tennis Open.name: Mario Tennis Open
Mario Tennis Open.summary: Instantly jump into the multiplayer fun, locally or online, as your Mii or your favorite Mushroom Kingdom character. Discover simple touch screen controls as well as strategic depth with different tennis swings, both which propel the tennis experience into an ever-intensifying crescendo of fun as the volleys go on.

Nicola Kanshuu - Model Oshare Audition P.name: Nicola Kanshuu: Model Oshare Audition Platina
Nicola Kanshuu - Model Oshare Audition P.summary:
Create your own character and work as an editor for the real Japanese teen fashion magazine "Nicola”. Pick out outfits, take photos, and make it all look perfect for print! Aim to become the best!

The 3DS edition of a larger series. Japan exclusive.
